title: Recheck the zodiac clock alignment threshold with measured figure positions
statement: An independent arithmetic check of the twelve stated rotations used the submitted fleet-fable object positions and the first clock marker on each submitted label line in pinned ZL3b-n.txt. For figure index j, compare its recorded clock to label index (j-k) modulo ring size, using shortest circular distance in hours; enumerate every k. All twelve stated shifts uniquely minimize mean distance. Eleven satisfy the specified strict 6/n-hour cutoff; f72v1 outer has mean 0.3225 hours against 0.3000 for n=20, so the stated universal threshold fails on these recorded inputs. The next-best mean on that ring exceeds the minimum by 0.08 hours. On most pages the recorded positions are nominal evenly spaced estimates rather than measured figure centers, so a 0.0225-hour excess neither proves a wrong label pairing nor independently verifies the drawing. This does not re-key every seat, measure inter-seat agreement, or establish that the marker is always the true attachment.
check: Measure independent figure centers and ring centers on the scan, blind to the label words and marker positions; derive actual clock angles, specify rounding and uncertainty before comparing. Recompute all cyclic offsets and their distances, including the 6/n threshold, and mark ambiguous offsets when measurement uncertainty overlaps. Re-key the seats only where attachment is supported; then evaluate agreement on corresponding objects and audit visually whether the labels belong to those figures. Preserve original annotations and identify corrected pairings. Do not treat the coarse nominal positions or an agreement boost as proof of attachment.

evidence.input: Existing fleet-fable picture.json for f70v2, f72v1, f72v2, f72v3, f73r, f73v and data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt. No held-out page selection or glyph words were consulted.
evidence.method: Extract numeric position immediately preceding o'clock, interpret hh:mm modulo 12, preserve the figure and original label order; for shift k compare position[j] to marker[(j-k)%n], mean of shortest absolute circular distances. Threshold is half the 12/n mean spacing.
